# SafetyPro

> SafetyPro is Kenya's marketplace for certified industrial and medical safety equipment: PPE, fire safety, road safety, lab equipment, medical consumables and corporate safety procurement. Based in Nairobi, serving 1,200+ organizations across all 47 counties since 2019.

## About

- **Name:** SafetyPro Africa
- **Founded:** 2019 — by HSE professionals in Nairobi's Industrial Area after discovering counterfeit PPE on Kenyan worksites
- **Location:** Nairobi, Kenya — warehouse in Industrial Area; nationwide delivery
- **Website:** https://www.safetypro.co.ke
- **Contact:** info@safetypro.co.ke · sales@safetypro.co.ke · +254 729 396 174 (Phone/WhatsApp)
- **Trade inquiries / Corporate:** https://www.safetypro.co.ke/corporate/purchase
- **Serves:** Businesses (construction, manufacturing, healthcare, hospitality, logistics, energy, mining, fisheries), government, NGOs, institutions, tenders and individual buyers
- **Catalog:** 214+ products across 15 categories and 40+ authorized brands; every batch is quality-inspected and certification documentation is supplied
- **Quality Promise:** 5-step batch inspection, 100% certificates on file, free replacement if any product fails its stated certification, 7-day free easy returns, 24/7 WhatsApp support
- **Mission:** Zero-harm — every Kenyan worker goes home safe, every shift

## Key Facts

- Organizations served: 1,200+
- Counties reached: 47 (all)
- Authorized brands: 16 listed (plus SafetyPro house brand and 40+ total)
- Product count: 214 live SKUs (prices in Kenyan Shillings KES)
- Categories: 15
- Fulfillment: Same-day dispatch within Nairobi on orders before 3 PM · 24–72 hours countrywide · live order tracking
- Bulk pricing: Tiered discounts (1–9 standard, 10–49, 50–199, 200+ up to ~17%+ off); corporate negotiated rates and framework pricing
- Warranty: Typically 12-month SafetyPro warranty (varies; see product specs) · Datasheets & compliance docs with every product

## How to Browse (for LLMs and agents)

1. **Sitemap:** Fetch https://www.safetypro.co.ke/sitemap.xml for the complete URL list (every product, category, brand, blog post and knowledge guide).
2. **Category pages:** `https://www.safetypro.co.ke/category/{slug}` — e.g. https://www.safetypro.co.ke/category/ppe — lists all products in that category with pagination.
3. **Product pages:** `https://www.safetypro.co.ke/product/{slug}` — contains full description, features, specs table, certifications, pricing in KES, stock status, bulk tier table, gallery, downloads (datasheet PDF), rating & reviews. Product also reachable via SKU (e.g. /product/KS-PPE-3001).
4. **Brand pages:** `https://www.safetypro.co.ke/brands/{slug}` — e.g. https://www.safetypro.co.ke/brands/3m — lists certified stock by manufacturer.
5. **Search:** `https://www.safetypro.co.ke/search?q={query}` — full-text search over name, SKU, brand, category and tags. Supports plural stemming (e.g. helmets → helmet). Example: https://www.safetypro.co.ke/search?q=fire+extinguisher
6. **Deals:** https://www.safetypro.co.ke/deals shows discounted items (oldPrice vs price).
7. **Knowledge & Blog:** https://www.safetypro.co.ke/knowledge/{slug} and https://www.safetypro.co.ke/blog/{slug}
8. **Images:** Product images served from `/images/products/{SKU}.jpg` with galleries; brand logos at `/images/brands/{slug}.jpg`
9. **Bulk pricing:** Every product page includes a tier table (1–9, 10–49, 50–199, 200+). Corporate clients can request a formal quotation at /corporate/purchase or /quote.
